title: English for Farsi Speakers
description: Practical, real-world English for Farsi speakers who want to travel and get by in everyday situations — greetings, airports, hotels, food, shopping, small talk, and handling problems. No grammar drills, no exam prep, just the phrases you'd actually use.

descriptionTranslations.fa: انگلیسی کاربردی و واقعی برای فارسی‌زبان‌هایی که می‌خواهند سفر کنند و در موقعیت‌های روزمره از پس خودشان بربیایند — سلام و احوال‌پرسی، فرودگاه، هتل، غذا، خرید، گپ زدن، و حل مشکلات. بدون تمرین‌های خشک گرامری، بدون آماده شدن برای امتحان، فقط عبارت‌هایی که واقعاً به کارت می‌آیند.

changelog.notes: Initial release: 18 decks of practical travel/communication English for Farsi speakers, using speech-recognition and listening/dictation cards alongside the usual tap-based types, with every card's English text played aloud automatically.
Every English phrase now ships with a recorded voice (pronunciations.csv), so pronunciation plays automatically and from the speaker icon on every phone, even ones with no text-to-speech engine.
Added source/glossary.csv (168 terms, extracted from each pack's own true_false preview statement) — every course now ships a glossary, per the flashcard-course-creator skill's updated rule.

New first decks teach reading from scratch, the way phonics does: a few letter SOUNDS at a time (s a t p, then i n m d, and so on), hearing each one, then real words built only from the letters learned so far (read the word, hear it, arrange its letters, say it). Letter names (A-Z) come last. The first packs of "Sounds & Survival Phrases" now also start by listening: hear the phrase, pick its Farsi meaning.
